question.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

exchange.sent: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

answer.answer:
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense, but for satellite payload/components they support these S-parameter/VNA capability priorities: group delay and phase measurements, component-level measurements for converters/mixers/amplifiers/filters/antennas, wide RF/mmWave frequency coverage, high dynamic range, low magnitude/phase uncertainty, stable calibrated system data, and fast/reproducible measurements [4][5][42].
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported Aerospace/Defense-related passages | Supported product/spec evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite payload testing includes group delay to determine transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion, and R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level group delay and phase measurements [4][5]. | R&S ZNA67 provides 10 MHz to 67 GHz frequency range, 2 or 4 ports, 1 Hz resolution, and 1 to 100001 points per trace [36]. |
| Component-level S-parameter coverage | Satellite component-level testing is called out for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [5]. | R&S ZNB3000 covers base frequency ranges up to 43.5 GHz and up to 54.0 GHz with frequency upgrade options [57]. |
| Wide RF/mmWave frequency range | Satellite payload/components testing covers RF components and payload subsystems, and the product passages provide VNA ranges for higher-frequency work [6][57][67]. | R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz with 1.0 mm male test ports and 2- or 4-port variants [66][67]. |
| High dynamic range | Dynamic range is a stated VNA specification condition and is especially relevant where transmission measurements must resolve low-level responses; ZNB3020 specifies ≥140 dB from 100 MHz to 24 GHz and ≥135 dB from 24 GHz to 26.5 GHz under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction [71]. | R&S ZNB3044 specifies ≥140 dB from 100 MHz to 20 GHz, ≥133 dB from 24 GHz to 45 GHz, and ≥130 dB from 45 GHz to 54 GHz under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction [76]. |
| Low transmission magnitude/phase uncertainty | Transmission uncertainty is a direct S-parameter accuracy capability; R&S ZNB3020 lists 0.06 dB / 0.7° from >9 GHz to 26.5 GHz for 0 dB to –20 dB transmission under matched-DUT, 10 Hz bandwidth, –10 dBm source, EDR-on conditions [70]. | R&S ZNB3044 lists 0.07 dB / 2.4° from >40 GHz to 54 GHz for 0 dB to –20 dB transmission under matched-DUT, 10 Hz bandwidth, –10 dBm source, EDR-on conditions [75]. |
| Calibrated effective system performance | Effective system data supports calibrated S-parameter confidence through directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking [72][77]. | R&S ZNB3020 effective system data with R&S ZN-Z235 calibration kit includes directivity ≥42 dB and transmission tracking ≤0.03 dB from 20 GHz to 26.5 GHz under 10 Hz bandwidth and controlled temperature/calibration conditions [72]. |
| 2-port and 4-port support | Component and subsystem testing can require more than two ports, and the ZNB3000 and ZNA67EXT passages list 2-port and 4-port variants [15][66]. | R&S ZNB3000 base units include 2-port and 4-port models from 4.5 GHz through 43.5 GHz base frequency ranges [15]. |
| Fast, reproducible measurement workflow | Satellite equipment manufacturers need reduced test time/cost, and test solutions should be straightforward, fast, reproducible, and provide high measurement performance and repeatability [42]. | R&S ZNL VNA measurement speed examples include 920 µs sweep time and 1.6 ms sweep cycle time at 500 kHz measurement bandwidth under the stated CW/S11/201-point conditions [87]. |

- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；內容 subject to change。

R&S ZNL20
[[R&S ZNL20]] 是 [[R&S ZNL]] 系列的 20 GHz 2-port Vector Network Analyzer，依 [[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]] Version 10.00（September 2025）標示，VNA frequency range 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz，test port connector 為 3.5 mm, male；加裝 [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 時 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）
- [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz，高於 R&S®ZNL20 的 VNA frequency range 5 kHz to 20 GHz；本頁依來源分別記錄，不合併。
- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。
- Frequency response referenced to 50 MHz，RF attenuation 0 dB/10 dB/20 dB/30 dB，+18 °C to +28 °C：10 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz < 0.8 dB（σ = 0.1 dB）；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz < 1.3 dB（σ = 0.2 dB）；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz < 2.0 dB（σ = 0.5 dB）；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz < 2.5 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz < 3.0 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）。
- Total measurement uncertainty 條件：signal level 0 dB to –50 dB below reference level、S/N > 20 dB、sweep time auto、sweep type sweep、RF attenuation 10 dB/20 dB/30 dB、span/RBW < 100、95 % confidence level、+18 °C to +28 °C。R&S®ZNL20：3 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz 為 1 dB；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 為 1.5 dB；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz 為 2.2 dB；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz 為 2.7 dB；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz 為 3.2 dB。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000 › 重點摘要
- Product data 適用條件：於環境溫度下存放 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 文件定義：Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表保證性能；non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證；uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 並依 GUM 計算。
- 共通 VNA 量測：impedance 50 Ω；number of test ports 2；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001；measurement bandwidth 1 Hz to 500 kHz，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 sequence。
- VNA frequency range：[[R&S ZNL3]] 為 5 kHz to 3 GHz；[[R&S ZNL4]] 為 5 kHz to 4.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNL6]] 為 5 kHz to 6 GHz；[[R&S ZNL14]] 為 5 kHz to 14 GHz；[[R&S ZNL20]] 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz。
- Test port connector：[[R&S ZNL3]]、[[R&S ZNL4]]、[[R&S ZNL6]]、[[R&S ZNL14]] 為 N, female；[[R&S ZNL20]] 為 3.5 mm, male。
- Dynamic range 規格條件：0 dBm source power 與 transmission magnitude data trace RMS value 的差；test ports short-circuited；10 Hz measurement bandwidth；without system error correction。使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Measurement accuracy 有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；依 port connector 使用 [[R&S ZV-Z270]] 或 [[R&S ZN-Z235]] calibration kit；TOSM/SOLT；measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 相同；不允許 interpolation。
- Spectrum analysis 為 option：[[R&S ZNL3-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL4-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL6-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL14-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL20-B1]]。搭配 spectrum analysis option 時，[[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 可到 26.5 GHz。

- [[R&S ZNL20]] — 5 kHz to 20 GHz，3.5 mm male test ports，Order No. 1323.0012.20；with [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] spectrum analysis option 時 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。

ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000 › 規格補強摘錄
- Transmission measurements uncertainty 條件：matched DUT、measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power –10 dBm。100 kHz to 6 GHz 時，0 dB to –40 dB 的 magnitude uncertainty 為 0.08 dB，phase uncertainty 為 0.5°；6 GHz to 20 GHz 時，0 dB to –30 dB 的 magnitude uncertainty 為 0.08 dB，phase uncertainty 為 0.7°。
- Trace stability 條件：source power 0 dBm、reflection 0 dB、bandwidth 10 kHz。Trace noise magnitude RMS：100 kHz to 10 MHz < 0.0035 dB，10 MHz to 6 GHz < 0.0025 dB，6 GHz to 10 GHz < 0.0030 dB，10 GHz to 16 GHz < 0.0035 dB，16 GHz to 20 GHz < 0.0045 dB。
- Test port input noise level 條件：measurement bandwidth 1 kHz，normalized to 1 Hz。ZNL3/ZNL4/ZNL6 群組：50 MHz to 4.5 GHz < –130 dBm (1 Hz)，typical –140 dBm (1 Hz)；ZNL14/ZNL20 群組：6 GHz to 16 GHz < –120 dBm (1 Hz)，typical –132 dBm (1 Hz)。
- Spectrum analyzer DANL 條件：termination 50 Ω、log scaling、normalized to 1 Hz RBW、RBW 1 kHz、VBW 1 Hz、sample detector、+18 °C to +28 °C、RF attenuation 0 dB。5 MHz ≤ f < 4.5 GHz < –140 dBm，typical –150 dBm；20 GHz ≤ f ≤ 26.5 GHz < –112 dBm，typical –120 dBm。
- I/Q data：interface GPIB or LAN；memory length max. 25 Msample I and Q；word length 14 bit；sampling rate standard 100 Hz to 45 MHz，with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] 為 100 Hz to 100 MHz。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 重點摘要

- Measurement range：impedance 50 Ω；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit **1 Hz to 1 MHz**；搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-K17]] 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option 時為 **1 Hz to 10 MHz**。
- 型號與頻率範圍：[[R&S ZNB3004]] 為 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B082]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B084]] 可到 9.0 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3020]] 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B262]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B264]] 可到 26.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3032]] 為 9 kHz to 32.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 可到 43.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3044]] 為 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 可到 54.0 GHz。

- Measurement speed 以 firmware version 4.12 與 Windows 11 測得；來源註明 sweep time 應理解為 cycle time。
- General data：operating temperature +5 °C to +40 °C；storage temperature –20 °C to +60 °C；calibration interval 1 year；power supply 100 V to 240 V ±10 %，50 Hz to 60 Hz and 400 Hz，max. 3.5 A。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › Payload 架構層級
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 將 satellite payload 技術演進描述為：

- Bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads。
- Digital regenerative payloads。

Bent-pipe satellite payload channel 的 high-level components 包含：

- uplink antenna
- low noise amplifier
- filter
- frequency converter
- filter
- high power amplifier
- filter
- downlink antenna
- local oscillator

Regenerative payload channel 在上述鏈路中加入：

- digital demodulator
- baseband processing and switching
- digital modulator

來源稱 regenerative payloads 可提升 system capacity 與 flexibility，但會增加 testing complexity。

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense, but for satellite payload/components they support these S-parameter/VNA capability priorities: group delay and phase measurements, component-level measurements for converters/mixers/amplifiers/filters/antennas, wide RF/mmWave frequency coverage, high dynamic range, low magnitude/phase uncertainty, stable calibrated system data, and fast/reproducible measurements [4][5][42].
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported Aerospace/Defense-related passages | Supported product/spec evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite payload testing includes group delay to determine transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion, and R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level group delay and phase measurements [4][5]. | R&S ZNA67 provides 10 MHz to 67 GHz frequency range, 2 or 4 ports, 1 Hz resolution, and 1 to 100001 points per trace [36]. |
| Component-level S-parameter coverage | Satellite component-level testing is called out for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [5]. | R&S ZNB3000 covers base frequency ranges up to 43.5 GHz and up to 54.0 GHz with frequency upgrade options [57]. |
| Wide RF/mmWave frequency range | Satellite payload/components testing covers RF components and payload subsystems, and the product passages provide VNA ranges for higher-frequency work [6][57][67]. | R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz with 1.0 mm male test ports and 2- or 4-port variants [66][67]. |
| High dynamic range | Dynamic range is a stated VNA specification condition and is especially relevant where transmission measurements must resolve low-level responses; ZNB3020 specifies ≥140 dB from 100 MHz to 24 GHz and ≥135 dB from 24 GHz to 26.5 GHz under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction [71]. | R&S ZNB3044 specifies ≥140 dB from 100 MHz to 20 GHz, ≥133 dB from 24 GHz to 45 GHz, and ≥130 dB from 45 GHz to 54 GHz under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction [76]. |
| Low transmission magnitude/phase uncertainty | Transmission uncertainty is a direct S-parameter accuracy capability; R&S ZNB3020 lists 0.06 dB / 0.7° from >9 GHz to 26.5 GHz for 0 dB to –20 dB transmission under matched-DUT, 10 Hz bandwidth, –10 dBm source, EDR-on conditions [70]. | R&S ZNB3044 lists 0.07 dB / 2.4° from >40 GHz to 54 GHz for 0 dB to –20 dB transmission under matched-DUT, 10 Hz bandwidth, –10 dBm source, EDR-on conditions [75]. |
| Calibrated effective system performance | Effective system data supports calibrated S-parameter confidence through directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking [72][77]. | R&S ZNB3020 effective system data with R&S ZN-Z235 calibration kit includes directivity ≥42 dB and transmission tracking ≤0.03 dB from 20 GHz to 26.5 GHz under 10 Hz bandwidth and controlled temperature/calibration conditions [72]. |
| 2-port and 4-port support | Component and subsystem testing can require more than two ports, and the ZNB3000 and ZNA67EXT passages list 2-port and 4-port variants [15][66]. | R&S ZNB3000 base units include 2-port and 4-port models from 4.5 GHz through 43.5 GHz base frequency ranges [15]. |
| Fast, reproducible measurement workflow | Satellite equipment manufacturers need reduced test time/cost, and test solutions should be straightforward, fast, reproducible, and provide high measurement performance and repeatability [42]. | R&S ZNL VNA measurement speed examples include 920 µs sweep time and 1.6 ms sweep cycle time at 500 kHz measurement bandwidth under the stated CW/S11/201-point conditions [87]. |

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

R&S ZNL20 › 文件與適用條件
- 相關來源：[[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]]。

- Recommended calibration interval：1 year。
- Data without tolerance limits is not binding；內容 subject to change。

R&S ZNL20
[[R&S ZNL20]] 是 [[R&S ZNL]] 系列的 20 GHz 2-port Vector Network Analyzer，依 [[ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000]] Version 10.00（September 2025）標示，VNA frequency range 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz，test port connector 為 3.5 mm, male；加裝 [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 時 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）
- [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz，高於 R&S®ZNL20 的 VNA frequency range 5 kHz to 20 GHz；本頁依來源分別記錄，不合併。
- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。
- Frequency response referenced to 50 MHz，RF attenuation 0 dB/10 dB/20 dB/30 dB，+18 °C to +28 °C：10 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz < 0.8 dB（σ = 0.1 dB）；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz < 1.3 dB（σ = 0.2 dB）；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz < 2.0 dB（σ = 0.5 dB）；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz < 2.5 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz < 3.0 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）。
- Total measurement uncertainty 條件：signal level 0 dB to –50 dB below reference level、S/N > 20 dB、sweep time auto、sweep type sweep、RF attenuation 10 dB/20 dB/30 dB、span/RBW < 100、95 % confidence level、+18 °C to +28 °C。R&S®ZNL20：3 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz 為 1 dB；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 為 1.5 dB；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz 為 2.2 dB；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz 為 2.7 dB；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz 為 3.2 dB。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 測試背景
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › Payload 架構層級
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 將 satellite payload 技術演進描述為：

- Bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads。
- Digital regenerative payloads。

Bent-pipe satellite payload channel 的 high-level components 包含：

- uplink antenna
- low noise amplifier
- filter
- frequency converter
- filter
- high power amplifier
- filter
- downlink antenna
- local oscillator

Regenerative payload channel 在上述鏈路中加入：

- digital demodulator
- baseband processing and switching
- digital modulator

來源稱 regenerative payloads 可提升 system capacity 與 flexibility，但會增加 testing complexity。

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list for Aerospace / Defense, but for satellite payload/components they support these S-parameter/VNA capability priorities: group delay and phase measurements, component-level measurements for converters/mixers/amplifiers/filters/antennas, wide RF/mmWave frequency coverage, high dynamic range, low magnitude/phase uncertainty, stable calibrated system data, and fast/reproducible measurements [4][5][42].
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported Aerospace/Defense-related passages | Supported product/spec evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite payload testing includes group delay to determine transmission-path phase distortions and channel band-edge distortion, and R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level group delay and phase measurements [4][5]. | R&S ZNA67 provides 10 MHz to 67 GHz frequency range, 2 or 4 ports, 1 Hz resolution, and 1 to 100001 points per trace [36]. |
| Component-level S-parameter coverage | Satellite component-level testing is called out for converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay, and phase measurements [5]. | R&S ZNB3000 covers base frequency ranges up to 43.5 GHz and up to 54.0 GHz with frequency upgrade options [57]. |
| Wide RF/mmWave frequency range | Satellite payload/components testing covers RF components and payload subsystems, and the product passages provide VNA ranges for higher-frequency work [6][57][67]. | R&S ZNA67EXT covers 10 MHz to 110 GHz with 1.0 mm male test ports and 2- or 4-port variants [66][67]. |
| High dynamic range | Dynamic range is a stated VNA specification condition and is especially relevant where transmission measurements must resolve low-level responses; ZNB3020 specifies ≥140 dB from 100 MHz to 24 GHz and ≥135 dB from 24 GHz to 26.5 GHz under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction [71]. | R&S ZNB3044 specifies ≥140 dB from 100 MHz to 20 GHz, ≥133 dB from 24 GHz to 45 GHz, and ≥130 dB from 45 GHz to 54 GHz under 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction [76]. |
| Low transmission magnitude/phase uncertainty | Transmission uncertainty is a direct S-parameter accuracy capability; R&S ZNB3020 lists 0.06 dB / 0.7° from >9 GHz to 26.5 GHz for 0 dB to –20 dB transmission under matched-DUT, 10 Hz bandwidth, –10 dBm source, EDR-on conditions [70]. | R&S ZNB3044 lists 0.07 dB / 2.4° from >40 GHz to 54 GHz for 0 dB to –20 dB transmission under matched-DUT, 10 Hz bandwidth, –10 dBm source, EDR-on conditions [75]. |
| Calibrated effective system performance | Effective system data supports calibrated S-parameter confidence through directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking [72][77]. | R&S ZNB3020 effective system data with R&S ZN-Z235 calibration kit includes directivity ≥42 dB and transmission tracking ≤0.03 dB from 20 GHz to 26.5 GHz under 10 Hz bandwidth and controlled temperature/calibration conditions [72]. |
| 2-port and 4-port support | Component and subsystem testing can require more than two ports, and the ZNB3000 and ZNA67EXT passages list 2-port and 4-port variants [15][66]. | R&S ZNB3000 base units include 2-port and 4-port models from 4.5 GHz through 43.5 GHz base frequency ranges [15]. |
| Fast, reproducible measurement workflow | Satellite equipment manufacturers need reduced test time/cost, and test solutions should be straightforward, fast, reproducible, and provide high measurement performance and repeatability [42]. | R&S ZNL VNA measurement speed examples include 920 µs sweep time and 1.6 ms sweep cycle time at 500 kHz measurement bandwidth under the stated CW/S11/201-point conditions [87]. |

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。
